author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a wide camera body with the viewfinder hump over the lens (right of centre, as in the reference) and a five-spike star burst above its top-left corner. Rejected candidates: an eight-spike asterisk filled in to a flower-shaped blob and sat exactly 8 from the body (review); a four-spike glint read as a plus sign ('add camera'). The rejected drawing had three dashes above a hump-less camera and a dot lens.
omissions: The star burst is a spiked star (no outline, since a closed star this small has no open centre at 48px); the small flash block under the star and the tick mark on the body are dropped; the lens is one ring instead of two.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'camera' (rounded body, raised top, circular lens) and 'sparkles' (radiating spikes).
